summary: A member responds more sharply when the interviewer presses the same point again.
realLife: On CNN after the first House bank rescue vote in 2008, John Roberts pressed Darrell Issa about the claim that Nancy Pelosi’s speech cost the rescue bill votes. Issa answered that he had been working on the bill and had missed her speech.
inGame: needs: a same-question repeat within the current exchange, distinct from prior meetings.
gates: The interviewer has already pressed this point.

turns.what: The member answers the follow-up in detail when the reporter narrows the question.
turns.pulledBy: The first answer addressed the vote and the second question asks about the amendment.
turns.writesBack: The interview gains an explanation of the amendment.

turns.what: Pressed a second time about a colleague’s remarks, the member cuts in to say they heard only the final sentence.
turns.pulledBy: The member entered during the speech and can identify when they took their seat.
turns.writesBack: The interview record limits the member’s first-hand account to the sentence they heard.
